title: Email header builder rejects CR/LF but passes ordinary unicode
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag that unicode subjects are passed through unencoded as an RFC violation, or that rejecting only CR/LF misses other control characters. The module's stated contract is the injection guard at the building layer: encoding for transport happens downstream, and CR/LF are the only characters that can terminate a header and smuggle new ones.
